rules: k 1, 2x-credit stop. Entry at the close of the month's first trading day: sell 1 set (65 CE + 65 PE) of the month's last NIFTY expiry. W = ATM CE + ATM PE close; CE strike = nearest 50 to spot + W, PE strike = nearest 50 to spot - W. If CE + PE close at or above 2 x the credit on any day before the expiry, both are bought back at the next day's open; otherwise both are held to the expiry day's close. Daily bhavcopy bars only. Net is after charges and 0.25 pt slippage per leg per side.
